reason: I already get free advice by pasting my portfolio into ChatGPT or Claude and then placing the trades myself in my broker app, which is free. I'm not adding a monthly subscription just to have an agent press the buttons for me, especially when you won't even tell me the price.
objection: Paying every month to invest feels like a fee eating my returns, and on top of that I'd be letting an AI pet move real money through a broker partner I can't name yet. I like asking AI first and then deciding myself.
would_change_my_mind: A free real-money tier, or a price under about $5 a month, plus a few months of the demo showing the agent actually did better than what I do on my own.
